messages.subject: Warning when running model on ordinal simulated data: information matrix could not be inverted
parts:
Hello,

I'm having trouble running a model on ordinal simulated data. When running the model, I receive the following warning:

"WARNING: Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified."

Here is a reprex:

``` r
library("lavaan")
#> This is lavaan 0.6-17
#> lavaan is FREE software! Please report any bugs.

# Specify Parameters for Simulation ----

populationSize <- 100000

itemLoading <- .7
standardThreshold1 <- 0.5
standardThreshold2 <- 1
standardThreshold3 <- 1.5
nonInvariantThreshold1 <- 0
nonInvariantThreshold2 <- 0.5
nonInvariantThreshold3 <- 1
mySeed <- 52242

# Specify Population Model ----

populationModel <-
  paste(
    '
    # Specify measurement model factor loadings
    dep =~ ', itemLoading, '*v1 + ',
              itemLoading, '*v2 + ',
              itemLoading, '*v3 + ',
              itemLoading, '*v4 + ',
              itemLoading, '*v5
 
     # Fix latent mean to zero
     dep ~ 0*1
 
     # Fix latent variance to one
     dep ~~ 1*dep
 
     # Specify residual variances of manifest variables
     v1 ~~ (1-', itemLoading, '^2)*v1
     v2 ~~ (1-', itemLoading, '^2)*v2
     v3 ~~ (1-', itemLoading, '^2)*v3
     v4 ~~ (1-', itemLoading, '^2)*v4
     v5 ~~ (1-', itemLoading, '^2)*v5
 
     # Specify thresholds of manifest variables
     v1 | (', standardThreshold1, ')*t1 + (', standardThreshold2, ')*t2 + (', standardThreshold3, ')*t3
     v2 | (', standardThreshold1, ')*t1 + (', standardThreshold2, ')*t2 + (', standardThreshold3, ')*t3
     v3 | (', standardThreshold1, ')*t1 + (', standardThreshold2, ')*t2 + (', standardThreshold3, ')*t3
     v4 | (', nonInvariantThreshold1, ')*t1 + (', nonInvariantThreshold2, ')*t2 + (', nonInvariantThreshold3, ')*t3
     v5 | (', nonInvariantThreshold1, ')*t1 + (', nonInvariantThreshold2, ')*t2 + (', nonInvariantThreshold3, ')*t3
    ',
    sep = "")

# Generate Population Data ----

populationData <- simulateData(
  populationModel,
  sample.nobs = populationSize,
  seed = mySeed)

# Specify Analysis Model ----

analysisModel <- '
 # Specify measurement model factor loadings
 dep =~ NA*v1 + NA*v2 + NA*v3 + NA*v4 + NA*v5
 
 # Fix latent mean to zero
 dep ~ 0*1
 
 # Fix latent variance to one
 dep ~~ 1*dep
 
 # Specify residual variances of manifest variables
 v1 ~~ NA*v1
 v2 ~~ NA*v2
 v3 ~~ NA*v3
 v4 ~~ NA*v4
 v5 ~~ NA*v5
 
 # Specify thresholds of manifest variables
 v1 | NA*t1 + NA*t2 + NA*t3
 v2 | NA*t1 + NA*t2 + NA*t3
 v3 | NA*t1 + NA*t2 + NA*t3
 v4 | NA*t1 + NA*t2 + NA*t3
 v5 | NA*t1 + NA*t2 + NA*t3
'

# Run Model on Generated Population Data ----

analysisModel_fitted <- lavaan(
  analysisModel,
  data = populationData,
  ordered = paste0("v", 1:5),
  missing = "pairwise",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "theta")
#> Warning in lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, : lavaan WARNING:
#>     Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could
#>     not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not
#>     identified.
```

messages.subject: Re: Warning when running model on ordinal simulated data: information matrix could not be inverted
parts:
I wanted to add that I was able to get a Monte Carlo simulation to fit in Mplus with the same model (even with a smaller sample). The Mplus reprex is attached.

Other users also seem to be experiencing the same warnings when fitting the WLSMV models in lavaan:
https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/2az5WWKkH6A/m/HGt8yAlrEwAJ
https://groups.google.com/g/lavaan/c/OuehWIUqdyM/m/OK9BI8csCQAJ

I'm not sure if this is a bug in lavaan or if there is a different way I need to formulate the model, because we should be able to estimate a WLSMV model to simulated ordinal data with a large sample; any help would be greatly appreciated.
-Isaac
